House Varros (Quest).title: House Varros (Quest)
steps: This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Vaslir Naiyth is located in the Obsidian Academy. As you enter the academy, she is located near the stairs in the back of the room on the right.
Vaslir Vharkith is located near the top of Ail'Vorith proper, next to some other Vaslir NPCs.

Although Laeran Birchshade cons as "Ready to attack", he does not attack on sight. He may either be killed for Vharkith's Research Notes or spoken with instead. Speaking with him also begins a separate optional quest involving the Birchshade Family Bracelet. See Laeran Birchshade for details.
Vaslir Maryn is located near Vaslir Vharkith in the upper area of Ail'Vorith, standing beside the large fountain. Vaslir Kiannes is also located nearby.

At this point there are two confirmed routes for obtaining Flask of Essairyl. You may gather elemental essences for Vaslir Maryn, or speak with Vaslir Kiannes and complete his water-sample task instead. You only need to complete one route.
Only the Air and Earth elementals are needed for this step. Water elementals can also be found around the shores near Ail'Vorith proper, but they do not provide the essences Maryn requests.
There are also Water elementals along the shoreline surrounding the city. Make sure you are hunting Air Elementals and Earth Elementals for this quest.
the Corpse Dust given to you by Vaslir Vharkith
Route B: Earn Essairyl from Vaslir Kiannes
Vaslir Kiannes is located near Vaslir Maryn and Vaslir Vharkith in the upper area of Ail'Vorith, near the fountain.
This is an alternative to gathering Essence of Elemental Air and Essence of Elemental Earth for Vaslir Maryn. You do not need to complete both routes.

Head to Sentinels Terrace, which resides above the Traders Terrace in Faelindral.

Give Briefing for Scout Gladebow to Scout Gladebow.

Tig's Measuring Quest.rewards: (exp); The Measure Stick; Lead Disk of the Apprentice
steps: You can only engage in the quest dialogue after reaching level 15 or higher.
You may first find Tig Pebblebank at the quarry of Sungreet Strand.
Note that if you're not level 15, the conversation stops here after a few sentences. Need Dialogue
You receive Lead Disk of the Apprentice from Tig Pebblebank.
Travel to Night Harbor and visit the Night Market. You can find Sproggets Bedsprings inside one of the building just to the left as you enter the Night Market from West Gate.
IMPORTANT - Do NOT purchase the rope from Sproggets. Simply take 2 silver from your inventory and hand it to Sproggets.
You receive Small Field Pack of Ropes from Sproggets Bedsprings.
Travel to Sungreet Strand and return to Tig Pebblebank.
Hand Small Field Pack of Ropes to Tig Pebblebank.
You receive Rope, Knotted, 500 Length from Tig Pebblebank.
You receive Tig's Survey Form from Tig Pebblebank.
You receive The Joy of Surveying from Tig Pebblebank.
You receive Advanced Surveying Volume I from Tig Pebblebank.
Need to verify if Tig's Survey Form auto-updates as you capture measurements.
Read over The Joy of Surveying, as it will provide instructions on how to capture measurements and how to identify piton objects in-game.
You now have to locate the various pitons around the quarry and use MUD commands with your Rope, Knotted, 500 Length to capture measurements.
Location 1(marker #2) is at the south eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (Left of the ramp in and out).
When you are at a given location, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.
This updated the rope to Knotted Rope Tied to Marker Two
Location 2(marker #1) is at the south western corner of the Quarry along the rim (near the ramp in and out of the quarry).
Travel back to the piton locations and use the MUD command `/take Rope`. The final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope.
Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.
If you forget to undo the rope with the MUD Command `/take Rope` you are met with the following:

Special Note: If you need to zone from aggro after taking off just one part of a rope, you can zone back and just take the other part off. You will not need to start over. This may be helpful for the last part if you are solo (w/ no FD) - since putting on and taking off the rope drops invis.
Location 2 is at the south eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (near the ramp in and out of the quarry).
When you are at location 2, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.
Location 3 is at the North Eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (Follow the rim North of the ramp in and out towards the Glass Flats zone).
Travel back to the piton locations and use the MUD command `/take Rope`. The final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope.
Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.

Location 4 and 5 are just north of the middle of the quarry. Look for the highest point. When you are at location 4, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.
Location 4 can be easily done through invisibility unless a cinder herald is roaming, his agro radius is massive.

Location 5 can be a challenge. The path up can be traveled invisible and is generally free from kill on sight mobs. At the top, there are 2 Spellshooters that SEE INVISIBLE, 4 goblins total near the marker.
If you are doing the quest at level 15, these goblins will be deep red. You can agro them and train them around if you need, but remember you need to place and then return to TAKE back the rope.
Travel back to the piton locations and use the MUD command `/take Rope`. The final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope.
Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.
You receive Tig's Survey Form from Tig Pebblebank.
Review Advanced Surveying Volume I provided by Tig Pebblebank earlier in the quest.
This book provides the basic mathematical formulas to calculate the correct answer to Tig's question.
Inspect Tig's Survey Form for the values captured by your measurements.
For this question, Tig wants the surface area, noted as A = L x W.
In Tig's Survey Form, this should equate to A = Length 1 x Length 2.
For this question, Tig wants the volume, noted as V = L x W x H in Advanced Surveying Volume I.
In Tig's Survey Form, this should equate to V = Length 1 x Length 2 x Length 3.
Give Tig Pebblebank your completed Tig's Survey Form.
You receive The Measure Stick from Tig Pebblebank.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

steps: Read Earth-Stained Note. As a new Druid character in Night Harbor, you will start with one in your inventory.

If you only hand in the eye...

Exit this room to the balcony to find Calaada Acaciathorn at the end of the balcony.
If you are not level 5 or higher when turning in the token...
If you are level 5 or higher when turning in the token...

Give Aaliyah the Notched Circle Token.
You receive Silken Offering Bag from Aaliyah.

You will need to use "/look shrine" command on each of the 3 shrines followed by "/take offering" or "/take note". Afterwards, you will have 2 offerings and 1 note.
While you are outside West Gate, be sure to kill A large rat for 1 x Raw Rat Meat for later in the quest. You can often find some for sale on a shifty gnome nearby as well.

Proceeding to the third shrine, you will note something abnormal...
Be sure to use /take note for this shrine...

Run past the West Bank and enter the Sojourner's Camp area of Night Harbor. Turn left and walk towards Wayfarers Hospice (Cleric / Paladin guild hall).
Before entering Wayfarers Hospice, turn right and follow the building until you find Milham the Mad and Willy located to the right of the guild hall.

Be prepared for combat with buffs and full health before turning in Willy's "Treat".
You will need to run to a nearby zone line to avoid killing Willy, as doing so will result in negative faction hits within the city.

You receive Sample of Willy's Spittle from Willy.

You receive your items back from Aaliyah.

The Claw Arena.title: The Claw Arena
The Claw Arena.rewards: Mask of the Gladiator; Faceguard of the Gladiator; Claw of the Gladiator; Gilded Claw of the Gladiator
steps: Need all dialogues as well as more information on the fights themselves, how the turn-ins work, etc.
In order to reach the arena, the only known way is to loot a Gilded Claw Compound Key through killing any of the claw members at the compound.
The entrance to the arena is behind the compound in the image above to the left, down a ramp to a locked door.
Once in the locked door there will be patrols that are aligned with the Claws roaming the halls.
In the locked door, there is a room to the right with an oddly colored wall that can be walked through.
It is safe to explore this area as all the NPCs are on the claw faction, aside from the slaves.

In order to start the arena you need to be AMICABLE to The Gilded Claws. This can be accomplished by killing many of the smuggler and bandits in the desert region. This includes smugglers in Fallen Pass, Shaded Dunes, and Sungreet Strand.
Shortly after a fight is started Ringmaster Vorn typically despawns with a 50 minute respawn timer.
When handed a note to spawn an encounter, Vorn stays available for a little while, making it possible to hand in multiple notes.
If you are on the same tier of fight, the encounter needs to be defeated before the next person can spawn the same encounter.
Different tiers can be started at the same time, be sure to have the correct person loot the proof of kill.

steps: This quest has two parts, both are dependent on the time of day within the game.

Part 1 of the quest in Shaded Dunes starts at 6 PM game time. If you complete Part 1, the Night Harbor version of Head Researcher Aashir will spawn and remain up until 6 AM game time. He will promptly despawn in Night Harbor at 6 AM. Requiring you to re-complete Part 1, in order to complete the reward turn in. It is recommended to complete Aashir's Journal before completing Part 1 of the quest.

Head Researcher Aashir is only up during the day time. He spawns at 6AM game time and will be attacked by the risen skeletons when they spawn at 6PM game time. Head Researcher Aashir is lower level than the risen skeletons so they will kill him, requiring you to wait until 6PM the next day. If you hail Head Researcher Aashir during the day he will dismiss you.
In Shaded Dunes around the entrance to Ancient Crypt, risen skeletons and cultists spawn promptly at 6 PM game time and will despawn at 6 AM game time. They are on a 7 minute respawn timer.
Equip Aashir's Journal into an open bag slot. Add each journal page and click Combine to create Aashir's Journal completed Aashir's Journal.
Locate Head Researcher Aashir near the Ancient Crypt zoneline in Shaded Dunes.
This can only be started after 6:00 PM game time once the risen skeletons have spawned nearby.
After a brief delay, Head Researcher Aashir will start walking through the ruins towards Night Harbor. He does not provide any additional speech at this point of time.
You are to escort him to the far end of the ruins, killing anything along the way. There can be upwards of 3-4 Risen Skeletons attacking him at once.

Plan for a small group to assist in keeping the Risen Skeletons off of Head Research Aashir. If Head Research Aashir dies while being escorted, you will need to wait until 6:00 PM game time the following in-game day to try again.
If there are any Risen Skeletons in the area, Head Researcher Aashir will rush to attack them.

Hale's Haul.title: Hale's Haul
steps: On the docks of Keeper's Bight, in the last ship, you'll find Captain Hale.
Captain Hale has asked for your assistance recovering five lost crates of goods from the bottom of the bay beneath the dock, which were lost in a recent storm.
The Salvaged Cargo Crate are resting on the bottom of the ocean. These are collected using MUD commands.
Additionally, the crates have a cooldown before they can be looted by another player. You will need to use the MUD /look command to confirm if a crate is lootable before attempting to pick it up.
Be mindful, as there are several a great bight shark swimming around the bay, which are level 20-30 and aggressive.

You receive 20 silver from Captain Hale.

A Winged Terror.title: A Winged Terror
steps: Witcher Sayyaad is located in the Necropolis found within Night Harbor. Enter the Necropolis from the south entrance with the purple "Concourse of Souls" banner and immediately turn right.
Kill Night Terror, a level 8 named bat that spawns only at night in the Necropolis Courtyard and Saltbreeze Park areas of Night Harbor.
Night Terror will drop one of three items randomly, which can be returned to Witcher Sayyaad for a reward.

steps: Locate Polietta Two-tone, who spawns in Evershade Weald during the day up on the hill near the Fae Guardians.
Hunt a black widow and an elder widow until you have collected 6 x Widow Eye.

House Ith'vayen (Quest).title: House Ith'vayen (Quest)

Part 1 - A Letter of Recommendation - Req. Lvl 1

Shaman Starter Quest (Underdocks).title: Shaman Starter Quest (Underdocks)
steps: The weapon progresses from Petrified Undercap Stem to Mycelial Staff, then Mycelial Spear. For the Mycelial Staff, complete Part 3, Step 1. The preserved-brain task in Step 2 upgrades it to the spear.
Part 1 - Starting Note and Shredded Cloak
Give Moldy Note to Picci Manifold.
You receive Shredded Cloak from Picci Manifold.
Part 2 - Four Blightspores and Petrified Undercap Stem
You receive Putrid Fungal Balm from Picci Manifold.
If you run out of balm, return the empty jar to Picci Manifold for replenishment.
Use the Putrid Fungal Balm (4/4) on a sickly undercap. They will attack you. Loot Blightspores. Return 4 Blightspores to Picci Manifold
You receive Petrified Undercap Stem from Picci Manifold.
Step 1 - Six Mycelium Roots and Mycelial Staff
You receive Mycelium Sack from Picci Manifold.

Gather six Undercap Mycelium Root and combine them in the Mycelium Sack. Known sources in Underdocks include level 5+ an undercap gatherer, an undercap scavenger, an undercap hunter, and an undercap truffian.
Give the Full Mycelium Sack to Picci Manifold.
You receive Mycelial Bonding Thread from Picci Manifold
Right-click the thread, it will transform your Petrified Undercap Stem into a Mycelial Staff.
Step 2 - Preserved Specimen and Mycelial Spear
You receive Specimen Jar from Picci Manifold.
Take a hunting party out of the North Gate and travel East and find the tunnel that leads to a blight consumed mushroom patch.
Collect the Blightspore Brain from a mindless blightspore, semi-rare spawn. This item is NO RENT.
Purchase Embalming Fluid from Telar Nur'gta in the Underdocks.
Combine the Blightspore Brain and the Embalming Fluid in the Specimen Jar to create the Preserved Specimen.
Return the Preserved Specimen to Picci Manifold.
You receive Jagged Chitin Spearhead from Picci Manifold.
Right-click the Jagged Chitin Spearhead to attach the spearhead.

Combine the container and return it to Klavel Sul.

Burning Bones.title: Burning Bones
steps: 20 Scorched Skeletal Remains (Talking to Cordellius is optional)
# Hail Cordellius Hollmion in Spellbinders of the Spire
# He will tell you that they are from skeletons killed via the Flameburst spell.
15 Burnt Bone Chips (Talking to Pedram is optional)
# Hail Pedram at the School of the Fourfold Path
# Pedram says, "Hail, Adventurer. I'm Pedram, assistant to the Tams."
# "Pedram lifts his head from a swirl of dancing cinders, his expression serene."
# Pedram says, "Ah...not mere ash.Not what you find in a hearth or the pit of pyre. You seek a flame that remembers."
# Pedram says, "Campfire, torchlight, forge heat...these flames are bereft of soul, fed by the spent remnants of life. But elemental fire...it's fire that lives, fire that hungers. It's not kind."
# You say, "where can I find elemental fire?"
# Pedram smiles faintly, more reverant than pleased.
# Pedram says, "Yes. Elemental fire is not tool. It's a presence...a spirit, if you will. It speaks in crackles and sizzles, and devours without pause."

# Pedram says, "Many will call upon spirits for light, war, or spectacle. Few truly understand what they bind, and fewer still survive when the bond breaks...when reverence is forgotten, and fire takes back what it's owed."
# Pedram says, "The bone chips you seek must be seared by such a fire. Not summoned, but enraged...by a fire spirit untethered."
# You say, "where can i find an untethered fire spirit?"
# Pedram lowers his voice, eyes reflecting a flicker of emotion.
# Pedram says, "There is one. Bound long ago within an ancient crypt by rites of the dead. It was enslaved through force, not honor, and it burns still with fury unspent."
# Pedram says, "Now it's surrounded by it's necromantic keepers, once masters of their craft, now minions to the very spirit they sought to command."
# Pedram says, "It's flames do not simply consume, they rage...they scar. They mark bones with the burn you require."
# Pedram straightens and gestures towards the school's tall shelves.

# Pedram says, "Before you go stumbling through ash and wrath, learn the tale. Seek the book titled Deference to the Flame; a Tale of Ash and Sorrow. It rests amongst the southern stacks, with our other teachings."
# Pedram says, "May you find what you seek...and survive the meeting."
# Hail A Fishwife in Saltbreeze Park
# Eventually she will tell you to talk to Jasmerin

# Jasmerin will tell you to go and see Chef Violyn at the Crimson Oasis (Inn with red drapes) near the north gate. Violyn will tell you that to make blackened fish bones you need either 1x Flux (alchemy) and 1x Fish Bones, or 8x Fish Bones. Blackened Fish Bones recipe trivials at 5 Cooking.
# hail Rallin Wizentrop at the Academy of Arcane Inquiry

# Enter Sungreet Strand and make your way to the Beetle Caves near the Quarry. On a small ledge near the bottom is a pile of gnome bones. '/look' then '/take skull'. Fight Blazed Revenant, a level 18-19 undead. Loot Singed Skull.

You receive Stonemason's Shirt from a wash maiden.
You receive Damsel's Cloak from a wash maiden.
You receive Patrol Pantaloons from a wash maiden.
Your task is to deliver cleaned laundry to various citizens in Night Harbor, collect their dirty laundry, and combine the dirty laundry in the provided basket to return to the wash maiden.
Find Mason Steinn in Night Harbor in the temple against the cliff between Sojourner's Camp and the Tannery. Follow the road north until you reach the temple.
Give Mason Steinn the Stonemason's Shirt:
You receive Steinn's Dirty Laundry from Mason Steinn.
You receive 5 copper from Mason Steinn.
Next, find Layith Kharem in Night Harbor up a ladder in Glimmermoon Hall behind the performance stage in Night Market.
You receive Layith's Autograph from Layith Kharem.
The purpose of this autograph is currently unknown. This may just be a flavor item.
Give Layith Kharem the Damsel's Cloak:
You receive 1 copper from Layith Kharem.
You receive Layith's Soiled Stockings from Layith Kharem.
Lastly, find Guard Iskandar in Night Harbor in front of the large palace gate at the east end of Saltbreeze Park.
Give Guard Iskandar the Patrol Pantaloons:

You receive 2 copper from Guard Iskandar.
In Byrthia's Laundry Basket, Combine: Steinn's Dirty Laundry, Layith's Soiled Stockings, and Iskandar's Padded Loin Guard to create Byrthia's Full Laundry Basket.
Return to a wash maiden and give her Byrthia's Full Laundry Basket.
You receive Crude Tailoring Sakk from a wash maiden.
At this stage in the quest, you need to choose either a shirt or robe as your reward, and the following quest steps will vary slightly.
Go to the tailor's shop in the Night Market of Night Harbor. The tailor shop is located behind the weapon and cloth armor merchants.
Give Noura the Tailor the Crude Tailoring Sakk.
You receive Crude Tailoring Sakk from Noura the Tailor.
You receive Bronze Boatwright's Key from Noura the Tailor.
You receive Backstrap Loom from Noura the Tailor.
To find her uncle's house, leave Night Market and head towards Saltbreeze Park. When you get to the entrance of Saltbreeze Park, turn right and walk through the small gate.

Immediately after passing through the gate you will spot a house behind the navigation signpost with some barrels and boxes. Go to the right of that building. Just around the corner on the left is a door with anchors on either side. Hold the key on your cursor and click on the door to open.

Inside of Noura's uncle's house, you will find two rooms. The entryway has two a cobweaver hatchling spawn points, and the bedroom has three spawn points which can spawn a cobweaver hatchling, a cobweaver spider, or a cobweaver avicularia (rare spawn).
Some notable items that can drop from these spiders include Ring of the Pauper, Salt-Crusted Hammer and The Ugly Doll.
Each of these mobs have a decent chance of dropping Crude Spider Silk and a 3-4 minute respawn timer. You need to collect 24 x Crude Spider Silk.
Equip the Backstrap Loom into a bag slot and use either the crafting menu or manually put 4 x Crude Spider Silk inside and combine to create 6 x Crude Silk Scraps.

While you are farming silk, be sure to use MUD Commands to explore the interior of the home, as there are several additional items that you can collect to gain a small amount of faction and experience.
While standing next to the workbench and anchor attached to the wall..
There is no known NPC in Night Harbor that reacts to the text "Nafas min Bahr", but perhaps you can find one?
You can /push lid to make a secret escape from the house, which is explained if you chose the Robe reward option.
If you crawled outside and want to get back in...
If you stand near the bench with the book...
Hold onto this diary, as you can hand it in later for experience and faction.
If you stand near the oven...
Hold onto this needle, as you can hand it in later for experience and faction.
Walking over to the crate in the corner of the room...
Stand on the crate in the corner of the room and check the shelf again...
Hold onto this doll, as you can hand it in later for experience and faction.
Finally, if you stand next to the chest...
Despite numerous items and MUD commands, the secret to opening this chest has yet to be discovered. Perhaps you know how to open this?
Once you have finished exploring the house and have crafted your 6 x Crude Silk Scraps, return to Noura the Tailor.
If you picked up Child's Diary, you may wish to read it to explain the handful of items you collected during your visit to the house.
Give Noura the Tailor your Bronze Boatwright's Key, Backstrap Loom, Crude Tailoring Sakk, and 6 x Crude Silk Scraps (these can be handed in while stacked).
You receive Dirty Crude Silk Shirt from Noura the Tailor.
If you picked up various items from Noura's Uncle's house, hand them in to Noura the Tailor.
Give Child's Diary to Noura the Tailor.
Give Large Sewing Needle to Noura the Tailor.

steps: You receive Small Storage Box from Guard Darek.

Ashira Warrior Bracer Quest.title: Ashira Warrior Bracer Quest
steps: Watch Captain Badawi wanders all about the upper garrison area of the city.
Quartermaster Obaid is located in the Garrison (near west gate) in Night Harbor, in a room adjacent to the area with soldiers hitting training dummies.
Quartermaster Obaid is looking for Ashira Warrior Bracer. These are an uncommon drop from an ashira warrior and other higher level ashira fighters.
Give Ashira Warrior Bracer to Quartermaster Obaid.
You receive Tattered Rawhide from Quartermaster Obaid.

Crude Prison Shiv (Quest).title: Crude Prison Shiv (Quest)
steps: Kalessa is located just inside the beginning of Blind Midden, opposite the room with Nibs Mudknuckle
If you are below (Indifferent? unknown, clearly tied to reputation)

Purchase the recipes for Shale Hilt and Crude Prison Shiv from Kalessa Velgarrith. The Shale Chunk and Rusty Metal Shard can be acquired by using the MUD command "/take water" while standing next to any of the water in Blind Midden and handing the resultant Sewer sludge, Crusted Midden Sludge, or Black Midden Sludge into any slime for a chance at getting the components.
Hand in a Crude Prison Shiv.
You receive 10 copper from Kalessa Velgarrith.

Necrolyte's Pouch Quest.title: Necrolyte's Pouch Quest
steps: Hail Bones. He is unable to talk, but will hand you Bones' Note of Tidings. The note mentions a list of necrotic procurement.
Say "list of necrotic procurement" to Bones.
Return 20 Bone Chips, 1 Skeleton Jawbone, and the list of necrotic procurement
Receive Necrolyte's Pouch (4 slot small belt pouch), Note of Gratitude.
2nd list. Say "take the list of charred procurements.

Stolen Gems.title: Stolen Gems
steps: This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Laren Drin'dar is located in the Foreign Quarter of Ail'Vorith.
Glaeron Kes'tel is located House Vael'xirith in Ail'Vorith.
Go and slaughter goblins in their camps until you find all four: Pilfered Topaz, Pilfered Ruby, Pilfered Sapphire, Pilfered Emerald. Give these to Glaeron.
You receive Legion Recurve (Fighters quest reward is the Legion Longsword ) from Glaeron Kes'tel.

Wilna's Ring.title: Wilna's Ring
steps: All dialogue is missing from this quest.
There may be breadcrumbs from Tessa Kentwell informing the player to find Poacher Wilna.
Poacher Wilna is one of three named poachers that can spawn in the bear caves in Keeper's Bight.
Kill Poacher Wilna and loot Wilna's Ring.
Give the ring to Tessa Kentwell in the Kentwell Tannery in Penshaw Village.
You receive Ring of Consequences from Tessa Kentwell.

steps: The turn-in only works during the day.

Ashira Tails Quest.title: Ashira Tails Quest
steps: Old Rankle is located in the Tannery in Night Harbor, in the second floor of a building on the north wall, above the leatherworking trainer.
Based on the surrounding room, it's trivial to guess Old Rankle is interested in collecting Ashira Tail.
Ashira Tail can drop from any Ashira mob.
Give 1 x Ashira Tail to Old Rankle.
You receive Tattered Rawhide from Old Rankle.

Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral).title: Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral)
steps: Sylvosa Pineweld is in the smelting area.
Wyrdguard Mithrilvine is right at the bottom of the Keeper's Lift.
Listener Maplebloom is at the campfire at the Balanced Branch.
Sersil Tangleroot is across from the lift.
Lorinthal Skybranch is in the tree trunk on the platform south of the Traveler's lift, behind the trader's area.
